description:
During September, 4 online E-Waste Awareness Sessions were successfully conducted
The sessions covered practical aspects of e-waste management.
• Understanding E-Waste: What constitutes e-waste, common examples and environmental concerns.
• How to Dispose of E-Waste Responsibly: Do's and don'ts and why e-waste should not be mixed with regular waste.
• Proper Disposal Channels: Importance of authorised collection and recycling channels.
• Segregation of E-Waste: How to identify and segregate e-waste from other waste streams.
• Reuse & Recycling: Responsible reuse and recycling of end-of-life electronic products.
• Environmental Impact: Consequences of improper disposal and responsible electronic consumption.
• Awareness Video: A video was shown to visually explain the e-waste lifecycle, disposal and recycling practices.
The sessions provided practical knowledge on how to segregate, handle and dispose of e-waste responsibly.
